name: dumdum-skills
description: AI building for humans. Plain English skills that help anyone build real software with Claude Code. No jargon, no assumptions, everything explained.

skills.name: dumdum:idea
skills.description: Tell me your idea and I'll help you shape it into something clear and buildable.

skills.name: dumdum:who-is-it-for
skills.description: Figure out who will use your project and what they need from it.

skills.name: dumdum:break-it-down
skills.description: Split your idea into small, buildable pieces ranked by importance.

skills.name: dumdum:sketch-it
skills.description: Describe what each screen or page looks like in plain language.

skills.name: dumdum:pick-tools
skills.description: Choose the right technology for your project, explained in plain English.

skills.name: dumdum:steps
skills.description: Turn your feature list into an ordered build plan.

skills.name: dumdum:start-project
skills.description: Set up a new project from scratch and get something running.

skills.name: dumdum:add-feature
skills.description: Add one new feature to your project, step by step.

skills.name: dumdum:fix-problem
skills.description: Find and fix what's going wrong, explained in plain English.

skills.name: dumdum:make-it-look-good
skills.description: Improve the visual design of your project.

skills.name: dumdum:test-it
skills.description: Check if your project works and report results in plain language.

skills.name: dumdum:explain-it
skills.description: Point at any file and get a plain English explanation of what it does.

skills.name: dumdum:review-it
skills.description: Look at your whole project for problems or missing pieces.

skills.name: dumdum:save-progress
skills.description: Save a checkpoint of your work with a clear description.

skills.name: dumdum:put-it-online
skills.description: Walk through putting your project on the internet, step by step.

skills.name: dumdum:tell-people
skills.description: Generate a README, description, and social post for sharing your project.

skills.name: dumdum:whats-happening
skills.description: Get a plain English summary of your project's current state.

skills.name: dumdum:teach-me
skills.description: Learn any concept from your project using analogies and examples.

skills.name: dumdum:glossary
skills.description: Get a jargon-free dictionary of every technical term in your project.

skills.name: dumdum:whats-left
skills.description: See remaining work as a simple checklist with priorities.

skills.name: dumdum:clean-up
skills.description: Remove unused code and organize files, with explanations.

skills.name: dumdum:take-notes
skills.description: Save a note about a decision, idea, or reminder into a project journal.
